I practised the presentation ten times before I gave it.
Before giving the presentation, I practised it ten times.
note: before + S + V, hoặc before + V-ing khi cùng chủ ngữ.

prompt_vi: Nối thành 1 câu, dùng after. (sau khi)
given: I couldn't walk for two months.
answers: After I broke my leg, I couldn't walk for two months.
I couldn't walk for two months after I broke my leg.
After breaking my leg, I couldn't walk for two months.
note: after + S + V, hoặc after + V-ing khi cùng chủ ngữ.

prompt_vi: Nối thành 1 câu, dùng while. (trong khi)
given: I was waiting for the train.
I met an old school friend.
answers: While I was waiting for the train, I met an old school friend.
I met an old school friend while I was waiting for the train.
I met an old school friend while waiting for the train.
note: while + quá khứ tiếp diễn (việc đang xảy ra), vế kia quá khứ đơn/tiếp diễn.

prompt_vi: Nối thành 1 câu, dùng despite + V-ing. (mặc dù / bất chấp)
answers: Despite not speaking the language, I made many friends because people were very welcoming.
note: Không có 'despite of'; phủ định: despite not + V-ing.

prompt_vi: Nối thành 1 câu, dùng so…that. (quá… đến nỗi)
given: I couldn't sleep the night before.
I arrived at the airport too early.
answers: I was so excited that I couldn't sleep the night before and arrived at the airport too early.
note: so + adj/adv + that + S + V (quá… đến nỗi).

prompt_vi: Nối thành 1 câu, dùng unless. (trừ khi = nếu… không)
given: I don't find a job soon.
I will go back to my home town.
Living in the city is expensive.
answers: Unless I find a job soon, I will go back to my home town because living in the city is expensive.
note: unless = if… not; sau unless dùng câu khẳng định, không thêm not.

prompt_vi: Nối thành 1 câu, dùng as a result. (kết quả là)
given: I practised English every day for a year.
I got a job in an international company.
answers: I practised English every day for a year; as a result, my confidence grew and I got a job in an international company.
I practised English every day for a year, and as a result, my confidence grew and I got a job in an international company.
note: as a result, + kết quả; trong 1 câu dùng '; as a result,' hoặc ', and as a result,'.

prompt_vi: Nối thành 1 câu, dùng although. (mặc dù)
given: It was the best experience of my life.
I met my future wife there.
answers: Although the trip was short, it was the best experience of my life because I met my future wife there.
note: Although…, … : KHÔNG thêm but. Although đầu câu → dấu phẩy.

prompt_vi: Nối thành 1 câu, dùng even though. (mặc dù (nhấn mạnh hơn))
given: I made dinner for ten people.
answers: Even though I had never cooked before, I made dinner for ten people and everyone loved it.
note: even though = although nhưng nhấn mạnh hơn; không dùng kèm but.
